title: Rain and flooding leave thousands of Gaza children without access to learning
summary: OCHA's November 13 situation report says rainfall and flooding affected 109 learning spaces in Gaza. At least 5,500 children remained unable to access learning because their learning spaces were damaged or inaccessible, as of November 10. The report says rain also damaged 15 safe spaces, child-friendly spaces and psychosocial-support tents, forcing activities to be suspended.

title: Palestinian killed by Israeli forces east of Gaza City
summary: WAFA reports that one Palestinian was killed early Friday by gunfire in al-Tuffah east of Gaza City and another was killed late Thursday in a drone strike near a tent in al-Mawasi west of Khan Younis.

title: Respiratory illnesses rise in Gaza as winter floods threaten displaced people, WHO says
summary: Reuters reports that WHO warned of rising respiratory illnesses in Gaza after heavy rains flooded tens of thousands of tents. WHO said acute respiratory infections were 33,000 cases higher than the same period last year and made up 11% of consultations; WHO said nearly one million displaced people live in flood-exposed areas.
